author: reek
body: Electrical Rules Check for Codex Circuits schematics. ERC validates connectivity, pin compatibility, reference designator uniqueness, and power flag presence. Every violation carries a severity, location, and human-readable message.

author: reek
body: Per-violation-type severity overrides. The user can downgrade errors to warnings, suppress violations entirely by setting them to info, or promote warnings to errors.

author: reek
body: Two pins on the same net are compatible (1) or conflicting (0). Rules: passive is compatible with everything. Input-input is fine. Two outputs conflict. Power-out plus power-out conflicts. Bidirectional is compatible with everything except output-output. Open-collector and open-emitter can share a net with each other and with inputs.
